notes.title: Patch 0.1.1: Bosses buffed and new Codex entries
notes.content: [p]Hey, everyone! This patch slightly buffs both Boss Encounters, especially when the Cepheus Constellation is active. We've also fixed some bugs and issues reported recently![/p][p]Our next patch is going to be an exciting one - we're doing a [b]major revamp for the Daze Talent Tree[/b], and it looks absolutely awesome. Stay tuned![/p][p][/p][h3]Game Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]New [b]Codex[/b] entry for the [b]Ardor System[/b];[/p][/*][*][p][b]Codex[/b] entries for mechanics not yet unlocked are now hidden;[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the [b]Codex[/b] entry for the [b]Flask[/b] Reward;[/p][/*][*][p]Aim assist now affects melee weapons, too;[/p][/*][/list][h3]Balance Adjustments[/h3][list][*][p]The [b]Witch[/b] can now throws her [b]Bombs[/b] to further distances;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Witchbombs[/b] are now lethal (both to the player and to enemies);[/p][/*][*][p]During its second phase, the [b]Beast[/b] is now immune to [b]Witchbombs[/b];[/p][/*][*][p]With [b]Cepheus[/b] active, [b]Cassius[/b] now launches [b]5[/b] bat projectiles instead of [b]3[/b];[/p][/*][*][p]During his second phase, some of [b]Cassius[/b]' bat projectiles are now [b]undeflectable[/b];[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Improved the [b]Abysm[/b] collision in the [b]Fountain[/b];[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for all the support, everyone, and please leave a Steam review if you can![/p][p]Have a nice day![/p][p]-Dan[/p]

notes.title: The Constellation Update
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840358/1fcd976fd774e4e7011247a5397305b9964043a5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Ry94nV9Qhew;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h1]✨ The Constellation System ✨[/h1][p]Activate Constellations to add difficulty modifiers to your Journey, in exchange for extra Souls![/p][p][/p][p]🔹 🍷   [b]Crater - The Cup[/b] – Flasks only heal 1 Blood now.[/p][p]🔹 🐦‍⬛   [b]Corvus - The Crow[/b] – Enemies attack more frequently and in greater numbers.[/p][p]🔹 ♊   [b]Gemini - The Twins[/b] – Add two random extra Corruptions to this Journey.[/p][p]🔹 👑  [b]Cepheus - The King[/b] – Bosses become stronger and add variation to their attacks.[/p][p]🔹 ✝️   [b]Crux - The Southern Cross[/b] – Bleeding becomes lethal and slightly faster.[/p][p]🔹 🧭   [b]Pyxis - The Compass[/b] – 5 Keys are required to open each Region's gate.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840358/dc1a2abca3c5759d3d379852be4e607c81517ae2.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]New Constellations will be added in upcoming updates.[/p][p]
[/p][h1]⭐  New Weapon - The Star of Yesteryear[/h1][p]A powerful boomerang that generates Ardor the more you deflect it. Charge it by spending Bullets.[/p][p]Star Upgrades[/p][p]🔹 [b]🔁  Trickstar[/b] – activate the Star to swap positions with it;[/p][p]🔹 [b]🩸 Bloodstar[/b] – activate the Star to detonate a bloody explosion around it;[/p][p]🔹 [b]🌟  Twinstar[/b] – generate the Star faster and enable multiple Stars in the air;[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840358/f884ab348a012c94162d8ce0fa3525f8c6935cc3.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Finish a Journey for the second time to unlock the Star.[/p][p]
[/p][h1]🙋 New Characters[/h1][p]🔹 [b]💡 The Lamplighter[/b] – a lone, affable Lamplighter that may appear during your Journeys and light your path;[/p][p]🔹 [b]🚬  Jules[/b] – a sarcastic assistant to Morrigan, helping you with Bloodstones, Talents and Sins;[/p][p]🔹 [b]💀   Sir Scully[/b] – Morrigan's smith and knight, helping you with Rotskulls, Weapons and Arts;[/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="213,240,239"][tr][td colwidth="213"][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840358/446ba3dce4c4c5adf17e5f9abc14785f81245e13.png"][/img][/p][/td][td colwidth="240"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840358/9f13a79b7c5eaf3cdf4e3923ca6dc0127fef748b.png"][/img][/p][/td][td colwidth="239"][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840358/d8b6c8daefe74bbd588992efa2e2244d2b4c1753.png"][/img][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="213"][p]Lamplighter[/p][/td][td colwidth="240"][p]Jules[/p][/td][td colwidth="239"][p]Sir Scully[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h1]💎  Capstone Talents[/h1][p]Impactful and dangerous Talents obtained at the end of a Talent Tree. Dramatically change your journey by choosing these Talents.[/p][p]🔹[b]❤️‍🔥 Heartburn[/b] – Gain 100 Max Blood. Lose 75 Blood at the start of every combat.[/p][p]🔹[b]🔴  Crimson and Scarlet[/b] – Can't go over 40% Blood. Recover Blood for all melee damage.[/p][p]🔹[b]🌕  Eclipse[/b] – Double all knockback. Enemies take massive damage from hitting the edges of arenas.[/p][p]🔹[b]🧵  Deathloom[/b] – The String has no cooldown. Lose a Dash usage.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840358/0e28c97f7ca61e0aabe1a3c7f76b089baa2d725a.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]💎  New Talents[/h1][p]🔹[b]⭐ Starstruck[/b] – The Star stuns enemies for 1s.[/p][p]🔹[b]🪞 Mirrorfold[/b] – Deflect the Star to create a Phantom duplicate of it. Shoot a Phantom Star to detonate it.[/p][p]
[/p][h1]⚔️  New Art Refinements[/h1][p]🔹[b]Moonslash[/b] - Riposte – Riposte deals heavily increased knockback;[/p][p]🔹[b]Hot Reload[/b] - Precise Shot – with your last Bullets, hit an enemy with Precise Shot to recover all your Bullets;[/p][p]🔹[b]Librarian[/b] - Crook – Crook briefly interrupts enemies.[/p][p]🔹[b]Deathspear[/b] - Bayonet – the Bayonet now deals 8 damage instead of 4.[/p][p]
[/p][h1]🌠  Achievements[/h1][p]Steam achievements have been added to the game! Acquire new weapons and meet new characters to complete them.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840358/fbffdb617b32fae62a12ccfea004b815cefa4185.png"][/img][/p][p]New Achievements will be added in each new update.[/p][p]
[/p][h2]Game Improvements[/h2][p]- New Blessing Screen UI;[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840358/3fbbd0ecc907669344a2cdeeaa0fb7dfa4c5fe67.png"][/img][/p][h2]Balance Changes[/h2][p]- Sins are now unlocked automatically after unlocking a certain Talent threshold;[/p][p]- Reduced Talent unlock cost;[/p][p]- Keys required for each Region reduced to 3;[/p][p]- After completing 3 Arenas in the same Region, that Region becomes Sanguinary, increasing Bleeding while in their arenas;[/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.0.9: Songs in Silk
notes.content: [p]Hello, friends! Aah, you probably don't know me yet, eh? I'm Lamplighter! We'll meet in some future Journey, I hope. Dan and the others are all busy listening to a 'Silksong' or something of the sort, so I'm here to bring you the news! Here's what Dan told me to say:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840358/4c321afac54737fb6e79254b0b78d81c7689f4ad.png"][/img][/p][p]"So, this is (hopefully!) the last patch before our first Major Update! We have two new Songs in the game - '[b]Quiromancy[/b]' for the Path of the Damned and '[b]Ethereality[/b]' for the Blue Flower! We've also squashed some bugs, too."[/p][p][/p][h3]Features[/h3][list][*][p][b]Ethereality[/b] - New theme for the Blue Flower;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quiromancy[/b] - New theme for the Path of the Damned;[/p][/*][/list][h3]Game Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Credits Screen is now skippable;[/p][/*][/list][h3]Balance Adjustments[/h3][list][*][p][b]Saturn Talent[/b] stun extension increased to 0.2s (was 0.1s);[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Cassius delaying his attack when changing directions;[/p][/*][*][p]Reroll button not working properly sometimes in the Talent Selection Screen;[/p][/*][*][p]Slitherbones death animation sometimes not playing;[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks for all the support, everyone, and please leave a Steam review if you can![/p][p]Safe travels![/p][p]-Lamplighter[/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.0.8: Bloom and some good news
notes.content: [p]Hey, everyone! This small patch features some visual upgrades for the game, adding bloom and glow to attacks![/p][p]Also, stay tuned for updates next month! As September approaches, we're going full steam ahead for our next Major Update, featuring a new weapon, new characters and the Constellation System![/p][p][/p][h3]Game Improvements[/h3][list][*][p][b]A new Bloom option under Graphics, controlling the amount of glow coming from attacks and white creatures[/b];[/p][/*][*][p][b]Updated the icons for the Gluttony, Envy and Sloth sins;[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840358/69b1a498649c3c6feb3a5d8dcfe88a02c11ccf96.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840358/a1059f783c332061cb5a83ae715198fa3fe51ca2.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840358/45aad33f597193410129775535fb54d157e4d52e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Some good news![/h3][p]One of (if not the most) popular request we've received so far were [b]Achievements[/b]. I knew we were going to implement them, but I didn't quite know when.[/p][p]Well, I'm happy to announce that Achievements are coming with the [b]Constellation Update[/b]! As we update the game, more achievements are going to be added with time, so stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for all the support, everyone, and please leave a Steam review if you can![/p][p]Have a nice day![/p][p]-Dan[/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.0.7: Revamped Tutorial and Hub Improvements
notes.content: [p]Hey, everyone! This patch mostly improves the tutorialization and readability of some key mechanics. Also, Execution has been tweaked to allow for more Executions against bigger enemies![/p][p][/p][h3]Game Improvements[/h3][list][*][p][b]Tutorial revamped to be shorter and more dynamic;[/b][/p][/*][*][p]The statues at the Arena Hub now display a list of every [b]Reward Type[/b];[/p][/*][*][p]The Arena Hub UI now displays the [b]Challenge type[/b] of challenge encounters;[/p][/*][*][p]Vastly improved the visual feedback of the [b]Envy Sin[/b]'s Bloodsteal effect;[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted enemy spawn positions in [b]Hallowed Circle[/b] and [b]Wicked Clearing[/b], in order to avoid enemies getting stuck at the arena limit;[/p][/*][*][p]Precise Shot targetting improvements;[/p][/*][*][p]Spikes now appear to deal damage before combat begins (don't worry, this damage is only visual!);[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Balance Adjustments[/h3][list][*][p][b]The Execution threshold is now percentage-based[/b]: it now scales to 15% of an enemy's max Blood, for a maximum of 10 Blood;[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Glutinous Escape mission not triggering correctly;[/p][/*][*][p]Inventory not being able to open in some situations;[/p][/*][*][p]Unusual infinite Dash bug when 'Hold Attack to repeat' is on;[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for all the support, everyone, and please leave a Steam review if you can![/p][p]Have a nice day![/p][p]-Dan[/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.0.6: The Crimson Powder Patch
notes.content: [p]Hey, everyone! As promised, the [b]Tactician[/b] and [b]Ardent Rage[/b] (now named [b]Crimson Rage[/b]) Talents have been reworked! We've also improved the readability of enemy attacks, and made more balance changes![/p][p]For the next patch, we plan on continuing to improve the game's conveyance of mechanics. We're also looking into improving the String's targetting, particularly when used with the Smokeshot, though that might take a while.[/p][p][/p][h3]New Features[/h3][list][*][p]New option to [b]Disable UI around Player [/b]added to the Graphics Tab;[/p][/*][*][p]New option to [b]Always Show Version Number [/b]during gameplay added to the Game Tab;[/p][/*][/list][h3]Game Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]The [b]Doll[/b]'s attack now displays a preview of her attack area, and its hit detection has been improved;[/p][/*][*][p]Attacking the [b]Vampire[/b]'s Sacrifice target deals damage to the Vampire and makes the Sacrifice bolt flash;[/p][/*][*][p]The attack preview for the [b]Specter[/b], the [b]Tombfeller[/b] and the [b]Beast[/b] boss are more accurate;[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Smokeshot[/b]'s targetting has been tweaked - it should be better now, but we hope to keep improving it on upcoming patches;[/p][/*][/list][h3]Balance Adjustments[/h3][list][*][p][b][u]Tactician Rework - After performing a Ranged Art, regular shots don't cost Bullets for 2s[/u][/b][u];[/u][/p][/*][*][p][b][u]Crimson Rage Rework - At 40% Blood or less, deal double melee damage for 3s after every kill[/u][/b][u];[/u][/p][/*][*][p][b]Execution buff - [/b]Self-damage on miss has been reduced ([b]10 to 5[/b]);[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Hit cooldown for [b]Spikes[/b] sometimes didn't trigger;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed skip glitch in the Corruption selection area (sorry, MuxaRez!);[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks for all the support, everyone, and please leave a Steam review if you can![/p][p]Have a nice day![/p][p]-Dan[/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.0.5: Lots of balance changes and reduced level scaling
notes.content: [p]Hey, everyone! We're getting a bit experimental with this one. Lots of balance changes, including the [b]Ardor System[/b], Talents such as Silkcloak and [b]Ghostrunner[/b], and [b]Cassius[/b]' Sacrifice![/p][p]For the next patch, we have big reworks planned for the [b]Tactician[/b] and [b]Ardent Rage[/b] Talents (they're a bit boring at the moment) and some more improvements for [b]Cassius[/b]' fight. We're also planning on reworking the Tutorial to become more dynamic, but that's probably coming in a patch later down the line.[/p][p][/p][h3]Game Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]New [b]Death Tips[/b] explaining how the [b]Execution[/b] and the [b]Ardor System[/b] works;[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy Icons in the [b]Codex[/b];[/p][/*][*][p]Added a third [b]Ardent Body Blessing[/b];[/p][/*][*][p]Swapped positions for the Death and Fate Blessings;[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted enemy spawn rates in some arenas;[/p][/*][/list][h3]Balance Adjustments[/h3][list][*][p][u][b]Soul Circle[/b] level scarling is much lower - that means you can now level up much faster;[/u][/p][/*][*][p][u][b]Ardor Levels[/b] have smaller sizes - that means it is easier to both gain and lose your [b]Ardor Level;[/b][/u][/p][/*][*][p][b]Silkcloak nerf[/b] - At Ardor S, you lose a bit of Ardor instead of taking damage;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ghostrunner buff[/b] - After [b]10s[/b] of not taking damage, you deal [b]5[/b] nonlethal damage on contact;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Deflect buff[/b] - Deflected projectiles now pierce enemies (and make a satisfying sound when hitting them, too!);[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cassius nerf[/b] - Sacrifice now only heals 25% of his Maximum Blood;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Precise Shot[/b] and [b]Smokeshot[/b] buff - both only cost 1 Bullet now;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fiery Dragon nerf[/b] - you now shoot [b]4[/b] projectiles (was [b]5[/b]);[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p][b]Controller device detection[/b] (PS or XBOX) improved;[/p][/*][*][p]Pickups not working properly during Slow Motion;[/p][/*][*][p]Menu option for 'Hold Shoot to repeat' not being selected properly;[/p][/*][*][p]Blessing text not being properly translated on language change;[/p][/*][*][p]Added some missing localization for French, Spanish and Japanese;[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted some chinese dialog text;[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks for all the support, everyone, and please leave a Steam review if you can![/p][p]Have a nice day![/p][p]-Dan[/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.0.4: Readability and Balancing (+a Sneak Peek for what's coming!)
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone! In this patch, we're reducing the damage of some problematic enemies and hazards, improving the readability of some items, and adding a Credits Screen![/p][p]For the next update, we hope to introduce more QoL and Accessibility features, make some trickier balance adjustments, and fix the bugs that escaped this patch.[/p][p][/p][h3]Features[/h3][list][*][p][b]Credits Screen[/b]: we finally have a credits screen! A lot of people poured a lot of work and love into this game, and we're thankful for every one of them;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hold Shoot to Repeat[/b] option now introduced in the Accessibility menu;[/p][/*][/list][h3]Game Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Greatly improved [b]Healing Statue[/b] meter readability;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Healing Statues[/b], [b]Directional Statues[/b], [b]Fungi[/b] and [b]Torches[/b] now display an outline showing their cooldown timer;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Healing Statue[/b] tutorial section added to the [b]Directional Statue[/b] tutorial;[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted positioning for the Training Grounds inside the Art Selection Area;[/p][/*][*][p]Better visual feedback for damage done via Directional Statues;[/p][/*][/list][h3]Balance Adjustments[/h3][list][*][p]Damage taken by the Player from [b]Abysms[/b] reduced to [b]5[/b] (was [b]10[/b]) and is non-lethal to the Player;[/p][/*][*][p]Slitherbones arrow damage reduced to [b]5[/b] (was [b]8[/b]);[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Boss pickup rewards appearing outside arena limits;[/p][/*][*][p]Slitherbones not dropping their arrow on taking damage;[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Also, here's a sneak peek for what's coming in September...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840358/f884ab348a012c94162d8ce0fa3525f8c6935cc3.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]The Star of Yesteryear[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for all the support, everyone, and please leave a Steam review if you can![/p][p]Have a nice day![/p][p]-Dan[/p]

notes.title: If you've been having crashes, please try Compatibility Mode!
notes.content: [p]We're trying out a fix for some game crashes that have been reported over the last week. If you've suffered a crash (or some arenas look really funky), please try Compatibility Mode and let us know if it works![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks![/p][p]-Dan[/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.0.3: The Bullet Hell patch
notes.content: [p]Hey, everyone! This patch is a beefier one. The Greed and Pride Sin have been reworked, the Revolver Aspects have been buffed, and the Slitherbones has been nerfed![/p][p]For the next patch, we plan on improving understandability of some key mechanics (such as healing statues and arena rewards) and continuing with our QoL improvements and bugfixes.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840358/617eaff05b90c25a5a160c2b1b2c1ae5bffe9927.gif"][/img][i]Silver Revolver 2.0[/i][/p][h3]Game Improvements[/h3][list][*][p][b]Greed Sin 2.0[/b]: You regain Bullets with every shot at Ardor B or higher. You lose an Ardor level when taking damage;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pride Sin 2.0[/b]: 2x Ardor at Blood above 50%. You take 2x damage from enemies;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Silver Revolver Aspect 2.0[/b]: your bullets have a 20% chance of ricocheting;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Light Revolver buff[/b]: your bullets have a 50% chance of stunning (was 20%);[/p][/*][*][p][b]Slitherbones nerf[/b]: arrow projectile speed reduced. Attack animation has been tweaked to improve readability;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Doll nerf[/b]: attack speed has been decreased;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Envy Sin buff[/b]: Healing from indirect damage doesn't get halved anymore;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Weapon Aspects[/b] now appear shuffled between all potential weapons;[/p][/*][*][p]Deflect time stop effect has been increased;[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p][b]Smokeshot[/b] sometimes not connecting when it should;[/p][/*][*][p]Path of the Damned spawn positions were weird;[/p][/*][*][p]Lanterns not appearing in the Inventory;[/p][/*][*][p]Flasks appearing over the new weapon after a Boss' first defeat, leading to confusion;[/p][/*][*][p]Dialog in chinese not wrapping over to the next line;[/p][/*][*][p]Getting infinite Lost Souls with 'Give Up' button exploit fix;[/p][/*][*][p]Statues tutorial softlock fix;[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840358/3f97b04c31ba6d07c32c34aadcbb26fcff4bbd3d.gif"][/img][/p][p]Thanks for all the support, everyone, and please leave a Steam review if you can![/p][p]Have a nice day![/p][p]-Dan[/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.0.2: Balance Changes, Fixes and QoL improvements
notes.content: [p]Hey, everyone! This patch mostly addresses QoL issues and some visual/experience bugfixes. For fans of the Revolver, we're also buffing the Precise Shot![/p][p]For the next update, we're looking into buffing/reworking the Greed Sin and introducing more QoL improvements. We're also investigating some crashes ocurring on the Steam Deck.[/p][p][/p][h3]Game Improvements[/h3][list][*][p][b]Precise Shot buff[/b]: damage increased from 2 to 4;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bloodtrigger nerf[/b]: explosion duration reduced, damage reduced from 10 to 8;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Speedrun timer[/b] now only ticks during combat;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hold Button to Repeat[/b] now only affects the attack button;[/p][/*][*][p][b]'Death is Inevitable'[/b] text changed to [b]'Death is Inevitable?'[/b] after Cassius' blood bolt;[/p][/*][*][p]Controls UI text now reads 'Exit' instead of 'Cancel';[/p][/*][*][p]Swapped 'Give Up' and 'Options' button positions;[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Enemies getting stuck at the corner of certain arenas;[/p][/*][*][p]Confusion around whether to hit or interact with certain Statues;[/p][/*][*][p]Cassius dash attack hitbox not working;[/p][/*][*][p]Codex statue not interactable in the Fountain;[/p][/*][*][p]Whims tutorial sometimes losing focus on the Controller;[/p][/*][*][p]Reticle Range option being reset after every arena;[/p][/*][*][p]Reroll UI appearing over dialog;[/p][/*][*][p]Game not saving after purchases with Morrigan;[/p][/*][*][p]'Glutinous Hubris' whim text bug;[/p][/*][*][p]Morrigan saying 'world' instead of 'word' in English dialog;[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks for all the support, everyone, and please leave a Steam review if you can![/p][p][/p][p]Have a nice day![/p][p]-Dan[/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.0.1: Hotfixes and a light gardening
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone, welcome to our first patch! This is mostly to address potential hard-locks and some complaints in regards to the spikes in the Witchery Woods.[/p][p]We hope to address further QoL and balance suggestions in upcoming patches.[/p][p][/p][h3]Game Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Give Up button - if you're stuck, you may end your Journey prematurely to escape;[/p][/*][*][p]Spikes now deal damage half as frequently;[/p][/*][*][p]Spikes have been reduced or removed in various arenas in the Witchery Woods;[/p][/*][*][p]Earthbreak description now mentions its stun duration;[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Hard-lock after rerolling arenas in the Arena Hub;[/p][/*][*][p]Cancel label appearing in UIs that can't be cancelled;[/p][/*][*][p]Morrigan talking about an upcoming Cassius' rematch after it already happened;[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks for all the support, everyone, and please leave a Steam review if you can![/p][p][/p][p]Have a nice day![/p][p]-Dan[/p]

notes.title: Early Access Available Now!
notes.content: [h1]The Early Access is available NOW![/h1][p]Starting [b]July 1st[/b], you are able to experience the Early Access version of BloodRush: Undying Wish![/p][previewyoutube="z0a_KKrhvTY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]BloodRush: Undying Wish[/b] is an extremely fast-paced hack n' slash roguelike set in a gothic, undying world. Dash, shoot and strike with ability combos, weaving between enemies like an improvised dance. Death is gone; bring her back. [/p][p][/p][h1]New Features on Early Access[/h1][h2]🌲🌲 The Witchery Woods 🌲🌲[/h2][p]🔹🧙‍♀️ [b]The Witch[/b] – A member of the Cult of Eternity, the Witch is a sarcastic and spirited expert in alchemy, necromancy and black magic. Suffering has never been so comical![/p][p]🔹😈 [b]The Beast[/b] – ...or what's left of it. The Witch's "child" is as dangerous as it looks.[/p][p]🔹🌲 [b]The Woods[/b] – dance in arenas devastated by spikes and fungi - a reflection of the chaotic and free spirit of its dweller.[/p][p] [/p][h2]👹 New Enemies[/h2][p]🔹🌊 [b]Ooze[/b] – a lumbering slime, result of nefarious experiments, that multiplies itself on death;[/p][p]🔹🪆 [b]Doll[/b] – fragile and fearful enemy that protects itself with an umbrella, pushing the player away;[/p][p]🔹🤍 [b]Soulmate[/b] – an empathic soul that protects another enemy, gently rotating around it. Dies if it distances itself too much from its loved one.[/p][p] [/p][h2]⚔️ New Weapons[/h2][p]🔹📔 [b]Gnossis Staff[/b] – A mystical Staff that specializes in displacing and manipulating enemies - pulling, pushing and stunning.[/p][p]🔹⚡ [b]Storm Dragon[/b] – A hungry and vengeful Blunderbuss that focuses on quick, potent, short-range damage.[/p][p] [/p][h2]🎃 Corruptions[/h2][p]Thanks to the Witch's shenanigans (hehehe), your enemies now transform during your Journey, evolving into more dangerous forms and receiving new powers, such as:[/p][p]🔹💀 [b]Blinkbones[/b] – flying Slitherbones that teleports on taking damage;[/p][p]🔹🧌 [b]Skullbearer[/b] – the Tombfeller becomes more resistant, and carries a Slitherbones on its shoulder;[/p][p]🔹🪆 [b]Vengeful Doll[/b] – a tankier Doll that reflects melee damage back to the player.[/p][p] [/p][h2]⚔️ Weapon Aspects[/h2][p]Modify your Weapon during the Journey, transforming or refining your attacks, such as:[/p][p]🔹[b]Spectral Blade[/b] – transform the Blade's third attack into a repeatable dash slice;[/p][p]🔹[b]Mirror Revolver[/b] – deflect projectiles with your Revolver shot;[/p][p]🔹[b]Wind Dragon[/b] – fly back with the Dragon shot, hitting enemies and dealing massive damage on collision.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840358/2ff5417634a84a40f40cfb9fc351a93b91bcbbfc.png"][/img][/p]

That’s right — we’ve just updated our demo, and now’s your chance to dive into the chaos, bloodshed, and gothic fury we’ve been carefully crafting.[/p][p][/p][h2]🔥 What's new in the updated demo:[/h2][p][/p][p]🩸 [b]Blessing System[/b] – Bind souls to activate powerful passive buffs.[/p][p]🔥 [b]Ardor System[/b] – Play with flair and rack up your style rank.[/p][p]💀 [b]Execution Ability[/b] – Execute weakened enemies to recover health.[/p][p]🏟️ [b]Arena Hub[/b] – Choose the order of your arenas and earn unique rewards in each.[/p][p][/p][h2]💡 Plus 10+ new Talents to explore, including:[/h2][list][*][p][b]Opportunist[/b] – Deal double damage when shooting enemies from behind.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Weaponmaster[/b] – Revolver kills double your melee damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Silkcloak[/b] – Become invulnerable while at Ardor rank S.[/p][/*][/list][h2]😈 Choose your Sin and shape your playstyle:[/h2][list][*][p][b]Wrath[/b] – Double melee damage at high Ardor, but lose max HP.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Greed[/b] – Recover bullets with every kill, but take more damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pride[/b] – Gain Ardor faster, but lose it when hit.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]This is a huge moment for us. We’ve been working tirelessly to bring [b]BloodRush[/b] to life, and now we finally get to share it with the world. Steam Next Fest is the perfect time for you to enter the world of [b]BloodRush: Undying Wish[/b] — and feel the thrill for yourself.[/p][p]So don’t wait — play the updated demo now and add [b]BloodRush[/b] to your Wishlist to stay on top of every slash, scream, and secret yet to come.[/p][p][/p][p]See you on the battlefield — hacking, dashing, and dancing through the carnage.[/p]

notes.title: A new demo for Bloodrush: Undying Wish!
notes.content:
Evening, everyone! Today we're launching a new demo for [b]Bloodrush: Undying Wish[/b], with a lot of new features...

[list]
[h3][b]New Features[/b][/h3]
[b]Blessing System[/b] – Activate passive buffs by binding Souls.
[b]Ardor System[/b] – Play with style to increase your rank.
[b]New Ability: Execution[/b] – Execute enemies to recover health.
[b]Arena Hub[/b] – Choose arena order and receive different rewards for each one.
Visual Improvements to the Tutorial.

[h3]+10 New Available [b]Talents[/b], such as...[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Opportunist[/b] – Shoot at enemies' backs to deal double damage.
[*] [b]Weaponmaster[/b] – Revolver kills double melee damage.
[*] [b]Silkcloak[/b] – Become invulnerable at Ardor S.
[/list]

[h3][b]Sins[/b] – Choose one at the start of each Journey to dramatically alter your playstyle[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Wrath[/b] – Double melee damage at high Ardor, but lose max health.
[*] [b]Greed[/b] – Recover Bullets with every kill, but become more vulnerable.
[*] [b]Pride[/b] – Double Ardor gain, but lose Ardor when taking damage.
[/list]

Feel free to comment and give feedback on our Steam forums and Discord!

Thank you for being with us on this journey!

notes.content:
We are happy to announce the release of our first free public demo on Steam!

Download now in the Steam page, and don't forget to add to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2471390/Bloodrush_Undying_Wish/

Here's a quick list of changes since the last demo (from BIG Festival):

[h2]New combos![/h2]
[list]
[*] Stringsnap: teleport behind your target without activating the String's cooldown!
[*] Stringhook: Interrupt and pull your opponents to you!
[/list]
[h2]New upgrades![/h2]
[list]
[*] Nine in the Chamber: +3 bullets to shoot down your enemies!
[*] Third Hate: Destroy the third enemy hit by Crossdash!
[*] Mirrorguard: Parry projectiles to deflect them with even greater force!
[*] Parry Shot: Parry enemies at a distance using Precise Shot!
[/list]
[h2]And other improvements![/h2]
[list]
[*] General rework of the Blue Flower arena - it's now way bigger and more detailed!
[*] Torch Rework - hit it to push and damage everyone around it (including yourself)!
[*] A save system!
[*] Visual rework of the main character!
[*] Visual rework of Cassius IV, Last of his Kind!
[*] New dialog portraits!
[*] Various bugfixes.
[/list]
